about: Every point where the mod meets BeamNG.drive. The Lua side is BeamNG's official modding (extensions, a camera mode, a vehicle extension). BeamNG's Lua sandbox forbids native code (ffi.load denied, no C function declarations), so the renderer is a version.dll proxy in Bin64 that the Lua reaches over loopback UDP. Each row becomes one HookRow.

columns.side: lua = mod script, native = renderer DLL
columns.target: BeamNG function, hook or interface method
columns.implementation: function that handles it (Lua or C++)

rows.purpose: load the Sonic extension when the mod is active
start on foot as Sonic; BeamNG's own key still enters and leaves cars
third-person camera behind Sonic; tells the body which way is forward
Sonic's run, boost and jump forces on the walking body
read BeamNG's own walking inputs (W A S D, Shift = boost, Space = jump)
put rings on the ground and know when Sonic is in the air
hand the renderer the camera, Sonic's body and the rings every frame
load the renderer in the game's main process; forward every version API
start reading Sonic Frontiers, hook the swap chain, open the UDP link
receive each frame from the Lua and answer with the Melty test state
receive this frame's camera, body, rings and events
draw Sonic, rings and the ring counter into BeamNG's finished frame
drop our back-buffer view before BeamNG resizes
stop BeamNG's walking controller from braking Sonic above a human sprint
open and close the Sonic Beam menu
speed limit on/off, top speed, boost acceleration, speedometer; saved in settings/sonicfrontiers_sonic.json

rows.target: obj:setNodeFrictionSlidingCoefs on the ball nodes; playerController gets no stick input so it locks the ball
rows.purpose: above glideKmh the ball slides instead of spinning hundreds of times a second (rolling losses, physics instability past ~550 km/h)

rows.target: obj:setTriangle on every triangle of the walking body (same nodes, pressure, collision)
rows.purpose: Sonic ignores the air; the body's drag would otherwise need forces that tear the soft body apart
Sonic only takes over plain free roam; tutorials, Discover, career, scenarios and missions keep BeamNG's own walking body

rows.target: spawn.safeTeleport from the menu button (never automatic)
rows.purpose: get Sonic back upright after a crash left the walking body on its side or wedged
